description: Refactor step M9, class A (docs/plans/codebase-refactor.md §6.5, K1 and K3 in §4.3): internal/api's org_handlers.go splits along its ten // --- section markers into one file per area and keeps only registerOrgRoutes. Each section's handlers go with their own helpers, in source order: the workspaces themselves to org_core_handlers.go (with ActivateOrg, which sat after the logo handlers but sets the session's active workspace and is registered with the workspace routes), the workspace logo to org_logo_handlers.go (uploadIsRasterImage, on the helper-home allowlist already for avatar_handlers.go, goes with it), the workspace members to org_member_handlers.go (with GetOrgLimits, the first handler of that section), people-teams to org_team_handlers.go, worker keys to worker_key_handlers.go, personal runner keys to runner_key_handlers.go, the hosted runner to hosted_runner_handlers.go (with hostedRunnerKeyName and workerOnlineWindow, constants the worker status and the guided copilot also read), worker status to worker_status_handlers.go (with GetOrgUsage and its window bounds), Agent Connector pairing and download to connector_handlers.go and project team grants to project_team_access_handlers.go. No helper is used by more than one of the new files, so none goes to a K3 home and the helper-home allowlist (M5) is unchanged. Preview with: go run ./internal/tools/declmove -n -spec internal/tools/declmove/specs/M9.json
